# FruitWave hand-tracking assets

- `vision_bundle.mjs` and files under `wasm/` come from `@mediapipe/tasks-vision` 0.10.14.
- `models/hand_landmarker.task` is the MediaPipe Hand Landmarker float16 model, version 1.
- Upstream project: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe
- Model source: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/hand_landmarker/hand_landmarker/float16/1/hand_landmarker.task
